verification.note: Reproduced by reading the code. addons/intelligence/app/workers/metadata.py:20 imports post_addon_event_sync from app.addon_events. The new _recompute_citations (metadata.py:490-528) calls it at :517-526 to emit intelligence.detailed_summary.citations_ready with drive=drive. workers/summaries.py:38-53 and :80-88, the pattern the touch-point list names, emit through the async post_addon_event wrapped in _emit_ws_event. addon_events.py is called, not edited, and does not appear in the touch-point list. The deviation is small and in substance it is correct. index_text_content (metadata.py:329) is a synchronous function, so the sync twin (addon_events.py:82-100) is the right choice. The twin does the same drive scoping and secret header as the async one, and it already has a precedent at processing_events.py:16/40. Because it was called directly, the summaries.py pattern was not followed exactly: no _emit_ws_event that tests could monkeypatch, and no logger.info. I could not see the diff, so I did not verify that line 20 is new to this commit. It is inferred from _recompute_citations being the new citation-recompute code.

specification_compliance: Touch-point list: the citations_ready emit in workers/metadata.py goes through app/addon_events.post_addon_event_sync. addon_events.py is not in the list, and the call is not the summaries.py _emit_ws_event/post_addon_event pattern the list names. The payload (file_id, drive, citation_count, no_citation_count) and the event name match summaries.py.
potential_unspecified_behavior: metadata._recompute_citations calls calculate_and_store synchronously inside index_text_content, while summaries.py runs it in an executor. Whether this blocks a worker event loop depends on how index_text_content is dispatched. I did not verify that.
regression_risks: Tests that monkeypatch summaries._emit_ws_event to capture citations_ready will not see the event emitted from metadata.py. They would need to patch metadata.post_addon_event_sync instead.
test_coverage: I did not check whether a test asserts the citations_ready emit from the metadata path.
